about: Gate 70 block Y (CT_B70_ONLY_Y=1 runs it alone with U and X): over a live game against the computer (cpu-4ply), each of the 14 Game-setup pills (vs Human, vs Computer, Online, No clock, eight clocks, White, Black) on its own fresh game: one tap keeps the game (US-R16 5a), arms ONLY the pill tapped (5c) with the shared words 'Tap again to discard your game' (5b), and the same pill tapped again replaces the game (5c); then block X's cross-control equality over the set, its floor raised from 4 control kinds to 14 here (15 in the full run). At kunal761 (375x761, insets 51/31): the subject is game state, not layout (gate 70's own note on J and K). NOT COVERED by this pair: the More sheet's New game, the lesson's Play this position and the setup Start, which blocks B, K and X0 drive in the full gate; a real tap on his phone.

breaks.name: 3plus1-shares-no-clocks-arm
breaks.why: the 3+1 pill arms with No clock's key, so tapping 3+1 turns No clock amber and one tap on No clock would then replace the game - the 15 Nov checker's plant B, green on every block before Y

breaks.name: black-arms-whites-key
breaks.why: the Black pill arms with White's key, so the colour pair confirm each other

breaks.name: white-replaces-without-asking
breaks.why: the White pill replaces the live game on its first tap, with no confirm (clause 5a undone for one control the older blocks never tap)
